title: Sylphx Instrument Evidence Envelope v1
description: Wire-level result contract for Sylphx local-first Instruments (Citra, Iris, Cue, Spine, Lookout, Locus). Evidence rides on every tool result; there is no evidence_first tool.

envelope_version.description: Family envelope major version. Bump only for breaking wire changes.

status.description: ok = usable payload; partial = usable with material gaps; error = no trustworthy primary payload.

tool.description: MCP/SDK tool or op name that produced this result.

product.description: Brand product id (not transitional package id).

engine.description: Engine family, e.g. rust-core, lookout-ts, locus-hybrid.

path.description: Optional subpath within the engine (layout, ocr-fusion, tfidf+ast, ...).

adapter.description: Optional external adapter id when a host binary was used (ffprobe, tesseract).

locators.description: Citeable positions. Domain-specific shapes allowed; empty only when none apply.

kind.description: page | cell | bbox | file_line | url_span | timestamp_ms | path_hop | chunk | other

payload.description: Domain twin / primary result body. May be object, array, or string; null only on error.

warnings.description: Non-fatal honesty notes (partial OCR, missing optional adapter, cache miss, ...).

gaps.description: Material absences the agent must not invent (no text layer, unknown impact, SSRF deny, ...).

kind.description: deterministic = locators/facts from local engines; scored_non_locator = optional model scores that must not override locators; inferred = non-authoritative.
